text:
Anika: deploy-bot rolled v8.1 (tokenizer merge) to canary @us-west 10% at ~22:03 UTC
Anika: seeing p99 generation jump from ~180ms -> ~820ms on canary hosts, routing shows kernel fallbacks
Ravi: did the tokenizer change increase avg token count per request? :thinking: 
Anika: quick sample: median tokens/request increased ~1.8x, short prompts split differently
Miguel: profile attached — kernel-decider oscillating between quant_fast and fallback_cuda_gemm
Miguel: profiler excerpt:
```
kernel_decider: selected_path=quant_fast (60%) -> fallback=cuda_gemm (p99 latency 780ms)
batcher: avg_batch_size=1.6 -> spikes to singletons during seqlen tail
kvcache: hit_rate drop 0.92 -> 0.65
```
Anika: kvcache hit rate tanking — tokenizer merge likely shifted prefixes so cache misses churn
infra-bot: autoscaler: added 4 nodes to canary pool at 22:08 UTC
Ravi: when KV hit drops we see more KV fetches -> larger working set -> kernel decider opts memory-bound kernels. sounds consistent
SRE Oncall: any noisy tenants on those hosts? check tenant attribution
Miguel: noisy-tenant-27 had a couple long runs but not fleet-wide explanation
Miguel: flamegraph: https://perf.internal/redwood/fg/2245678901 (perm:eng-runtime) — CPU stall in prefetcher
Anika: host logs:
```
[2026-03-14T22:05:02Z] req_id=xyz tokens=142 -> tokenized=210 seq_len=210
[2026-03-14T22:05:02Z] kvcache: miss for prefix=<sha256:...>
[2026-03-14T22:05:03Z] kernel_switch: path=fallback_cuda latency_ms=743
```
Ravi: seq_len jumps blow up token-projection and increase per-token runtime; also causes batcher to avoid batching (high runtime variance -> tail penalty)
Anika: batcher snapshots show latency-aware window shrank to 5ms because of high variance -> batch size small
Miguel: kernel-decider mispredictions happen when seqlen distribution shifts; quant kernels assume short, stable contexts
Anika: hypothesis: tokenizer merge increased subtokens for many short prompts, creating a long seqlen tail -> KV cache churn + kernel mismatches + smaller batches
SRE Oncall: recommend rollback of canary and pause rollout to 0% until investigated :no_entry:
Anika: +1, rollback to v8.0 and run controlled tests with token-length histograms
deploy-bot: rollback command: `deploy rollback canary v8.0 --force` (initiated)
Anika: rolling back now
Miguel: pushed instrumentation patch to log per-route tokenization histograms (low overhead) to help reproduce
Ravi: suggestion: temporary kernel-decider guard — if kvcache_hit_rate drops >10% in 5m, disable quant path on host to avoid oscillation
Miguel: I can enable host-level flag to prefer stable CUDA kernels until quant path recalibrated for new tokenizer
Anika: tests to run after rollback: - full re-canary with synthetic short-prompt set - record per-route token distribution - run kernel-selection sim with seqlen distribution variants
SRE Oncall: rollback finished at 22:14 UTC, canary back to v8.0
Anika: p99 back to baseline ~190ms on canary hosts (prelim)
Ravi: next: reproduce locally with tokenizer-merge + perf harness, tune quant thresholds or update heuristics for tokenizer changes
Miguel: opening ENG-RUNTIME-1429 with profiler dumps + suggested guard, assigning to eng-runtime; update rollout checklist to include token-distribution smoke tests
Anika: assigning action items in ticket. closing this thread for incident updates, will post follow-ups there. :white_check_mark:
